pack_name: KYE Insurance Underwriting & Claims Authority Pack

claim_set.claim_text: Every AI-assisted underwriting decision that moves toward a consequential adverse action (declining an applicant, issuing an adverse-rate offer, applying an exclusion, rescinding cover) MUST map to a recorded named-authority decision — the agent, the applicant / decision artefact, the intended consequential action, and the named underwriter / underwriting authority under whose authority it proceeds. Decisions lacking a recorded authority decision are refused at the action-admissibility gate.

No AI-assisted underwriting or claims decision may drive a consequential adverse action against an applicant or claimant without a recorded adverse-action reason-code and the evidence the reason rests on — the specific reason, the principal factors and data fields that drove it, and the pinned source for each material factor — so the applicant / claimant receives a meaningful, specific reason. A black-box decline without a recorded reason-code is refused and never proceeds.

Every AI-assisted claims determination that moves toward a consequential adverse action (denying a claim, reducing a settlement, declining on a fraud-flag, rescinding cover) MUST map to a recorded named-authority decision — the agent, the claim / determination artefact, the intended consequential action, and the named adjuster / claims authority under whose authority it proceeds. Determinations lacking a recorded authority decision are refused and routed dual-channel to the responsible claims authority.

Every AI-assisted underwriting or claims decision that proceeds to a consequential adverse action MUST emit a signed, replay-provable fairness-evidence record binding the proxy-discrimination check applied (the protected-class proxy test, the disparate-impact / unfair-discrimination check result, the data fields tested, and the named-authority outcome) — so the decision is provably tested against unfair discrimination. A consequential decision without captured fairness-evidence is refused and never proceeds.

Every AI-assisted underwriting or claims decision that proceeds to a consequential adverse action MUST carry an appeal / contestability record — a stable decision identifier, the inputs and authority and evidence it rested on, the applicant / claimant's right to human intervention, and a reconstruction / appeal route — so that when the decision is contested (a GDPR Art. 22 request for human intervention, a regulator's market-conduct inquiry, an adverse-action appeal under the NYDFS / Colorado regimes) it can be reconstructed exactly as made and contested through a recorded route.

KYE governs the AUTHORITY + EVIDENCE + DEFENSIBILITY of AI-assisted insurance underwriting and claims decisions and PROVES they are fair and contestable — who authorised the adverse decision, the adverse-action reason, the fairness-evidence, and whether it can be reconstructed and contested. KYE does NOT price risk, write the policy, set the risk appetite, or replace the actuary / underwriter / adjuster.
